All six paragraphs retain their desktop order. The visible mobile paragraph line counts are 2, 6, 8, 2, 5 and 2. Long sentences wrap naturally inside the narrow column; each paragraph starts at the same left margin without indentation.

Every rightmost character is visible within the mobile margin, including wrapped paragraph endings and the higher-dimensional expression. There is no visible horizontal page overflow, overlapping text, rendering error or raw math delimiter.
The final paragraph is separated cleanly from the blue navigation link displaying zero exercises. No figures, questions, answer inputs or options appear anywhere in the complete screenshot.
